prompts: Use case: compositing. Create one polished landscape BRAND SPLASH IMAGE for BRUNDLEFLY, using Image 1 as the approved brand art-direction reference and Image 2 as the mascot identity reference. NOT a multi-panel brand board and NOT a website screenshot: one finished clean hero/banner composition. Retain the excellent original brand: nearly black graphite background, cream distressed industrial condensed wordmark, small low-contrast decayed biological texture or compound-eye pattern at the outer edges, rotten olive accents, and amber-eye/damaged-mint-wing colours. The mascot must remain gross and unsettling, a deformed human-fly mutation with ragged coat, diseased uneven eyes and dangling wet mouthparts. Preserve crisp BLOCKY 2D Terraria-inspired pixel art for the creature: sharp square pixels and stepped contour, no toy, no glossy 3D, no cute face, no smooth vector creature. Wordmark positioned large on the left, mascot on the right, generous clear space between, strong dark negative space; full-body creature clearly visible with a safety margin. Distressed wordmark must be fully legible. Exact and ONLY permitted text anywhere in the image is "BRUNDLEFLY", spelled B R U N D L E F L Y, ONCE. Remove ALL other writing from Image 1, including "machine meets flesh", "still a better listener", hero copy, captions, palette labels, hex codes, navigation, buttons, slogans, specimen labels and tiny marginal words. No letters, numbers, labels, symbols pretending to be text, watermark, pseudo-writing or extra caption elsewhere. Do not invent any text. Opaque canvas, landscape 3:2, intentional horror developer brand. Keep the wordmark and palette consistent across variations. MASCOT VARIATION 1: the original fly mutant brought low into a tense crouch, hunched segmented spine, one giant and one sunken amber compound eye, crooked clawed hands near the floor, torn mint wings standing above its back, ragged cream coat on one shoulder. Make the posture tense and predatory, hunched but not a cute squat. Dark dripping green mouthparts visible. Closest to the approved mascot, more powerful silhouette. A restrained low olive texture near its feet. No extra prop or scene.
